scope: Complete unchanged 4ac5b0 and 4ac6b0 execute over unsigned edge/random counters and divisors. New consume APIs compare original EAX (consumed whole-period product) and entire 0x200 actor storage. Original EDX/EBX/ECX preservation also checks. Zero divisors, zero/below/exact/remainder counters and high-bit values are covered. Legacy wrap APIs compare state only; native invalid storage guards preserve memory and return zero.
